# XPath

Query XML with XPath (//book[price < 10]/title, count(//item)).

Category: Testers · ID: `xpath` · Search terms: xml, query, xquery, select, nodes

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui xpath [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. XML

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--expr` | text | `/` | Expression. XPath 1.0; / is the document |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/xpath`), so they are what the tool prints.

### library-cheap-books

Input:

```text
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<library>
  <!-- prices in EUR -->
  <book id="b1" lang="en">
    <title>Sayings of the Century</title>
    <price>8.95</price>
  </book>
  <book id="b2" lang="es">
    <title>Cien años de soledad</title>
    <price>12.99</price>
  </book>
  <book id="b3" lang="en">
    <title>Moby Dick</title>
    <price>8.99</price>
  </book>
</library>
```

Output:

```text
<book id="b1" lang="en">
  <title>Sayings of the Century</title>
  <price>8.95</price>
</book>
<book id="b3" lang="en">
  <title>Moby Dick</title>
  <price>8.99</price>
</book>
```
